DAYS.title: Me
DAYS.goal: I can introduce myself. Say five true sentences about yourself, without reading.
tasks: Lesson 1 and Sound Lab (sp- and st-)
Shadow "My script"
Word Order and Speech Mode: Meet someone new
Voice note: Tell me about yourself. 30 seconds, no reading.

DAYS.title: Order and ask
DAYS.goal: I can order food and drink. Order a drink and something to eat, and pay.
tasks: Lesson 2 and Sound Lab (the English h)
Shadow "Ordering coffee"
Fill the Gap and Speech Mode: Café order
Voice note: Order your real breakfast in English. 30 seconds.

DAYS.title: Questions
DAYS.goal: I can ask for what I need. Ask where, what time and how, and ask for something politely.
tasks: Lesson 3 and Sound Lab (short i and long ee)
Shadow "At the airport"
Flash Translate and Speech Mode: Airport check-in
Voice note: Ask me three questions. I will answer them.

DAYS.title: Yesterday
DAYS.goal: I can say what I did. Say three things you did yesterday and how it was.
tasks: Lesson 4 and Sound Lab (-ed endings)
Shadow "Yesterday"
Word Order and Speech Mode: Chat about yesterday
Voice note: What did you do yesterday? 45 seconds.

DAYS.title: Opinions
DAYS.goal: I can give my opinion. Say what you think, give a reason, and agree or disagree.
tasks: Lesson 5 and Sound Lab (th)
Shadow "My opinion"
Fill the Gap and Speech Mode: Coffee chat: opinions
Voice note: The city or the beach? Say why. 45 seconds.

DAYS.title: Keep talking
DAYS.goal: I can keep a conversation going. Ask for a repeat, ask what a word means, and send the question back.
tasks: Lesson 6 and Sound Lab (v and b)
Shadow "Keep talking"
Flash Translate and Speech Mode: Meet someone new, without Help me
Voice note: The first minute of your talk: who you are and what you like.

DAYS.title: The 2-minute talk
DAYS.goal: I can talk for two minutes. Give a two-minute talk in four parts, with no script.
tasks: Lesson 7 and Sound Lab
Shadow your own talk
Rehearse against the 2-minute clock
Day 7 call: give the talk to your tutor

phr: I'm learning English because I want to travel.
Can I have a sandwich, please?
Could I have a window seat, please?
How do I get to the station?
I had dinner with my family.
Last week I watched a film.
I think it's a good idea.
I like it because it's easy.
Sorry, could you say that again?
How do you say this in English?
COURSE.bad: I don't know nothing about it.
COURSE.good: I don't know anything about it.

phr: Today I'm going to talk about me.
To finish, next year I'm going to travel.

RULES.name: Age with "have"
RULES.tip: Use "be" for age: "I am 25 years old."

RULES.name: Missing subject
RULES.tip: English always needs a subject: "It is raining."

RULES.name: "Explain me" / "say me"
RULES.tip: Say "explain it to me" or "tell me".

RULES.name: "For" + verb
RULES.tip: Use "to" for a purpose: "to learn English".

RULES.name: Present with "since"
RULES.es: Spanish uses the present: "vivo aquí desde".
